intro: Eritrea stretches along the Red Sea, from cool highlands to the hot Danakil Depression.

chapters.title: Land
text: Highlands around Asmara are cool and green in the rainy season. The coast is hot, and the Dahlak Archipelago has coral reefs. The Danakil in the south-east is one of the hottest places on Earth.

chapters.title: Climate
text: Rain is scarce, and droughts are common.

places.title: Landscape tour
places.intro: Places that show the variety of Eritrea's landscapes. The numbers match the pins on the map.
